method: primary or official source; transfer/non-transfer/limitation recorded

cases.mechanism: Cryptographically verifiable provenance manifests and edit history.
cases.transfer: Adopt signed provenance receipts, revocation status and explicit separation between provenance and truth.
cases.non_transfer: Do not make a C2PA-valid asset automatically true or safe.
cases.limit: Coverage depends on adoption and intact metadata.

cases.mechanism: Semantic detection, attribution and characterization of manipulated media.
cases.transfer: Combine multiple forensic signals and keep analytic uncertainty visible.
cases.non_transfer: Do not translate defence research into pervasive civic surveillance.
cases.limit: Automated detectors drift as generation methods change.

cases.mechanism: Open benchmark evaluation for manipulation detection and localization.
cases.transfer: Use blind tests, validators, versioned datasets and multiple performance metrics.
cases.non_transfer: Do not publish one leaderboard score as a universal certification.
cases.limit: Historic benchmarks may not represent current local media and languages.

cases.mechanism: Govern, map, measure and manage AI risks with TEVV resources.
cases.transfer: Use named owners, pre-release gates, monitoring, incident response and human oversight.
cases.non_transfer: Do not claim NIST alignment equals regulatory approval.

cases.mechanism: Public register explains municipal AI systems and allows feedback.
cases.transfer: Publish purpose, data, operator, oversight, lifecycle status and feedback route.
cases.non_transfer: Do not limit transparency to web users; retain staffed and paper access.
cases.limit: Disclosure quality depends on continuing departmental updates.

cases.mechanism: Algorithm register plus procurement clauses and lifecycle tools.
cases.transfer: Bind evidence disclosure to procurement and supplier contracts.
cases.non_transfer: Do not copy legal clauses without Chinese law and procurement review.
cases.limit: A register can become ceremonial if audit and remedy are weak.

cases.mechanism: Problem scoping, co-funded PoC/MVP delivery, engineering teams and knowledge transfer.
cases.transfer: Stage validation from scoped problem to PoC, production readiness and handover dossier.
cases.non_transfer: Do not promise identical funding or eligibility.
cases.limit: Requires sponsor capacity, data readiness and co-investment.

cases.mechanism: Risk engineering links evidence about AI performance to insurance products.
cases.transfer: Design a reproducibility dossier that underwriters may inspect.
cases.non_transfer: The commons must not set premiums or guarantee insurability.
cases.limit: Commercial underwriting criteria are product- and market-specific.

cases.mechanism: Media literacy is embedded in education and lifelong learning.
cases.transfer: Pair public verification with repeatable teacher-led learning and non-formal education.
cases.non_transfer: Do not assume Finnish curricula or institutions can be copied directly.
cases.limit: Learning outcomes require trained educators, not only tools.

cases.mechanism: Retained industrial heritage supports culture, design, creative industry and public life.
cases.transfer: Use retained railway fabric as working civic infrastructure, not scenery.
cases.non_transfer: Do not equate heritage branding with proven local conservation status.
cases.limit: Local ownership, conservation and fire-safety conditions remain decisive.

cases.mechanism: Issuer-holder-verifier model, trust lists, selective disclosure and auditability.
cases.transfer: Use minimum disclosure, revocation and offline/proximity verification patterns.
cases.non_transfer: Do not require a smartphone wallet for public access.
cases.limit: The EU legal trust framework does not apply automatically in Beijing.
